invariants.rationale: The method always returns an instance of BulkInsertPartitioner; there are no paths returning null.
The method accesses strategyParams regardless of which branch is taken (containsKey, get), so it must not be null.
The method uses schema (e.g., as an argument to HoodieSchemaUtils.addMetadataFields), so it cannot be null.
If the strategy parameter for sort columns is present, JavaCustomColumnsSortPartitioner is constructed; otherwise, a different partitioner is returned.
Negation: the type of 'result' directly corresponds to the presence or absence of the sort columns parameter key.
